scenario.name: r-cd-chained-depth-2
scenario.description: Depth-2 delegate chain: parent→child→grandchild→return path. Three sub-tests: (1) up-tree silent-wake, (2) inter-session return, (3) echo+broadcast via fanoutMode.

invocation.promptTemplate: Proof chain nonce {{nonce}}: you are depth-1. Fire your own continue_delegate(mode='silent-wake', task='Grandchild nonce {{nonce}}: reply exactly GRANDCHILD-DONE {{nonce}} only after you arrive. Do not mutate files.'). After the nested continue_delegate tool result reports scheduled, reply exactly CHILD-DONE {{nonce}} CHILD-DELEGATE-SCHEDULED.

expectedReceipts.name: child-spawns
expectedReceipts.description: Post-dispatch, non-harness session event contains strict CHILD-DONE {{nonce}} CHILD-DELEGATE-SCHEDULED sentinel

expectedReceipts.name: child-fires-grandchild
expectedReceipts.description: CHILD-DONE sentinel confirms depth-1 delegate executed the nested continue_delegate instruction

expectedReceipts.name: grandchild-spawns
expectedReceipts.description: Post-dispatch, non-harness session event contains strict GRANDCHILD-DONE sentinel

expectedReceipts.name: grandchild-returns
expectedReceipts.description: A nonce-bound grandchild identity and exact GRANDCHILD-DONE sentinel are observed after dispatch acceptance

expectedReceipts.name: parent-receives-chain-return
expectedReceipts.description: The exact root session receives GRANDCHILD-DONE {{nonce}} as a structured role=system return event, bound to distinct child and grandchild identities

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Trace ID for chain visualization in Tempo

review.notes: Depth-2 chain proof. PASS-candidate requires strict child/grandchild sentinels, two distinct nonce-bound hop identities, and an explicit role=system GRANDCHILD-DONE {{nonce}} receipt in the exact root session. Grandchild assistant output alone is not return authority.

liveRunSafety.notes: Live depth-2 chain row. Prefer OPENCLAW_CREATE_DISPOSABLE_SESSION=true. Detector ignores prompt echoes and ordinary GRANDCHILD-DONE assistant output; PASS requires distinct hop identities plus the exact root role=system return receipt.
